name: Sensitive Data in SharedPreferences
description: Sensitive data appears to be stored in SharedPreferences without recognized protection.
remediation: Use platform-backed secure storage for credentials and other sensitive values, or encrypt the value with appropriately protected keys before persistence.

name: Sensitive Data Written to a Plain File
description: Sensitive data appears to be written to a file without recognized encryption or secure-storage protection.
remediation: Avoid writing sensitive data to ordinary files. When persistence is required, encrypt the content and protect encryption keys with the platform keystore or keychain.

name: Sensitive Data in an Unprotected SQLite Database
description: Sensitive data appears to be inserted or updated in an SQLite database without recognized field or database encryption.
remediation: Use an encrypted database implementation or encrypt sensitive fields before insertion, with keys protected by the platform keystore or keychain.

name: Sensitive Data Written to External Storage
description: Sensitive data appears to be written to an external or broadly accessible storage location.
remediation: Store sensitive data in application-private storage and apply encryption when the threat model requires it. Do not place credentials or private records in external storage.

name: Sensitive Data Written to Cache or Temporary Storage
description: Sensitive data appears to be written to cache or temporary storage where retention and cleanup may not be reliable.
remediation: Avoid caching sensitive values. If temporary persistence is unavoidable, encrypt the content, minimize retention, and securely delete it as soon as possible.

name: Sensitive Data in WebView Browser Storage
description: Sensitive data appears to be written to WebView localStorage, sessionStorage, or cookies.
remediation: Do not persist credentials or private records in WebView browser storage. Keep sensitive state in protected native storage and expose only the minimum data required by the WebView.
